title: Summer 2026: Cards, Dashboard, and Payment Upgrades
body_markdown:
Hi there,


💳 Earn 2% back on card spend - Every swipe now works a little harder. Get 2% cashback on eligible card purchases — money back in your account, automatically.


🧾 Pay bills with your credit card - Free up cash flow by paying vendor bills directly with your Truss card, even when they don't take cards.


📲 Faster Tap to Pay - We've optimized Tap to Pay so getting paid on the jobsite is quicker and smoother than ever.


✨ A cleaner card experience - We've refreshed the card UX to make managing spend, limits, and cards easier across your team.


⚡ Faster approvals - Getting started just got quicker — we've sped up application approvals so you can start moving money sooner.


🔒 Built to protect you - Behind the scenes, we've shipped new fraud protections and security hardening to keep your money safe.


[See what's new →](https://app.trusspayments.com/dashboard/accounts)

Best,
The Truss Team
